events.title: Leveraging Single Particle Fluorescence Spectroscopy For The Diagnosis Of Parkinson’s Disease And Other Synucleinopathies
events.location: Queensland Brain Institute, The University of Queensland (St Lucia)
events.description: A high-level scientific seminar focused on cutting-edge biophysical techniques for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis, hosted by UQ's research experts.

events.title: Creative Brain Week - Day 1 (KINDLE)
events.location: Mary Emelia Mayne Room, Mayne Medical Building, Herston
events.source: The School of Public Health, University of Queensland
events.description: Part of a multi-day series exploring the intersection of neuroscience and the creative arts, focusing on how creative processes kindle cognitive development.

events.title: Creative Brain Week - Day 2 (ATTUNE)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.source: The School of Public Health, University of Queensland
events.description: This session examines the concept of 'attunement' within the brain, exploring how we resonate with artistic performance and collective creative experiences.

events.title: Beautiful Minds: a QBI exhibition at GOMA
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: A visually striking exhibition showcasing the intersection of neurobiology and art, featuring imagery captured through advanced microscopic observation.

events.title: 🥳 Party Games Night @ New Farm Library
events.description: An informal and welcoming social gathering focused on board and card games, designed for meeting new people and engaging in playful social interaction.

events.title: Creative Brain Week - Day 3 (THRIVE)
events.location: Global Change Institute, The University of Queensland, St Lucia
events.source: The School of Public Health, University of Queensland
events.description: The concluding day of Creative Brain Week focusing on how creative engagement sustains mental well-being and helps the human brain thrive in modern environments.

events.title: Beautiful Minds: a QBI exhibition at Creative Hearts Co
events.description: A regional touring version of the QBI 'Beautiful Minds' exhibition, merging complex scientific imaging with aesthetic appreciation in a local community setting.
